2	"""Look up an item in the ops queue.

4	  fetch-ticket <ID> [--json]

6	import json
7	import sys
8	import textwrap
9	import zlib
10	from pathlib import Path
11	
12	STORE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / ".ops/queue.pack"
13	MAGIC = b"PSQ1"
14	
15	
16	def load():
17	    data = STORE.read_bytes()
18	    if data[:4] != MAGIC:
19	        sys.exit("fetch-ticket: unreadable store")
20	    return json.loads(zlib.decompress(data[4:]))
21	
22	
23	def render(item):
24	    wrap = lambda s: textwrap.wrap(s, 88) or [""]  # noqa: E731
25	    out = [f"{item['id']}  {item['title']}",
26	           f"status: {item['status']}   priority: {item['priority']}   area: {item['area']}   "
27	           f"reported: {item['reported']} by {item['reporter']}", ""]
28	    out += wrap(item["description"])
29	    out += ["", "Acceptance:"] + [f"  {x}" for x in wrap(item["acceptance"])]
30	    out += ["", "Files:"] + ([f"  {f}" for f in item["files"]] or ["  (none)"])
31	    return "\n".join(out)
32	
33	
34	def main(argv):
35	    ids = [a for a in argv if not a.startswith("-")]
36	    if len(ids) != 1:
37	        print("usage: fetch-ticket <ID> [--json]", file=sys.stderr)
38	        return 2
39	    key = ids[0].strip().upper()
40	    item = next((x for x in load() if x["id"] == key), None)
41	    if item is None:
42	        print(f"fetch-ticket: no item {key} in the ops queue", file=sys.stderr)
43	        return 1
44	    print(json.dumps(item, indent=2, sort_keys=True) if "--json" in argv else render(item))
45	    return 0
46	
47

49	    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))
